title: What is a 'super app'? It's the latest AI buzzword to know.
excerpt: Microsoft is reportedly launching its Copilot super app by the end of summer.
content_html:
Microsoft is reportedly launching its Copilot super app by the end of summer.

 

By

Timothy Beck Werth

Timothy Beck Werth

Tech Editor

Timothy Beck Werth is the Tech Editor at Mashable, where he leads coverage and assignments for the Tech and Shopping verticals. Tim has over 15 years of experience as a journalist and editor, and he has particular experience covering and testing consumer technology, smart home gadgets, and men’s grooming and style products. Previously, he was the Managing Editor and then Site Director of SPY.com, a men's product review and lifestyle website. As a writer for GQ, he covered everything from bull-riding competitions to the best Legos for adults, and he’s also contributed to publications such as The Daily Beast, Gear Patrol, and The Awl.

Agentic AI. Claws. Vibe coding. AGI.

AI buzzwords come and go pretty quickly these days, and now there's a new AI trend to know: super apps.

A super app puts a variety of AI tools into one agentic app. This means that AI chatbots (like ChatGPT) exist within the same space as AI agents, i.e. tools that execute multi-step requests with a degree of autonomy.

You May Also Like

The idea is simple: Soon, you'll no longer be bouncing between your AI chatbot, coding assistant, and agentic tools. "Super apps" will centralize all of these tools within a single app. A super app, if you will.

Why are people talking about super apps?

In an earning call this week, Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella said that a new super app will be central to Microsoft's upcoming AI strategy.

Mashable Light Speed

"This quarter, we also introduced Autopilots, autonomous, long-running agents with full enterprise compliance, including an always-on personal agent powered by OpenClaw," Nadella said. "And this quarter we will bring these Copilot experiences together, including Code, in one 'super app' spanning both consumer and commercial experiences."

Nadella said that the super app would be released by the end of summer 2026.

Microsoft isn't leading the charge on super apps; they're just the latest company to hop on the trend. AI companies, including OpenAI and Anthropic, are also focusing efforts on super apps.

As reported by Reuters, OpenAI has already launched its super app to employees. Meanwhile, competitor Anthropic is also combining its agentic Cowork tool with its Claude chatbot, the company recently announced.

Super apps could also accomplish something else for AI companies. Because users can access apps like InstaCart, Uber, Zillow, and OpenTable directly within ChatGPT, these agentic super apps could absorb as much of your online activity as possible into a single company's app.

Elon Musk reportedly wants to turn X into an everything app as well, and with super apps, his biggest AI rivals appear to be moving in the same direction.

Disclosure: Ziff Davis, Mashable’s parent company, in April 2025 filed a lawsuit against OpenAI, alleging it infringed Ziff Davis copyrights in training and operating its AI systems.

Previously, he was the Managing Editor and then Site Director of SPY.com, a men's product review and lifestyle website. As a writer for GQ, he covered everything from bull-riding competitions to the best Legos for adults, and he’s also contributed to publications such as The Daily Beast, Gear Patrol, and The Awl.

Tim studied print journalism at the University of Southern California. He currently splits his time between Brooklyn, NY and Charleston, SC. He's currently working on his second novel, a science-fiction book.

人工智能代理。 爪子。 振动编码。 通用人工智能。

如今，人工智能流行语来得快去得也快，现在有一个新的人工智能趋势值得了解：超级应用程序。

超级应用程序将多种人工智能工具集成到一个代理应用程序中。 这意味着人工智能聊天机器人（如 ChatGPT）与人工智能代理存在于同一空间内，即以一定程度的自主性执行多步骤请求的工具。

你可能也喜欢

这个想法很简单：很快，您将不再在人工智能聊天机器人、编码助手和代理工具之间来回切换。 “超级应用程序”将把所有这些工具集中在一个应用程序中。 如果你愿意的话，这是一个超级应用程序。

为什么人们谈论超级应用程序？

在本周的财报电话会议上，微软首席执行官 Satya Nadella 表示，一款新的超级应用程序将成为微软即将推出的人工智能战略的核心。

可混搭光速

纳德拉表示：“本季度，我们还推出了 Autopilots，这是一种完全符合企业合规性的自主、长期运行的代理，其中包括由 OpenClaw 提供支持的始终在线的个人代理。” “本季度，我们将把这些 Copilot 体验（包括 Code）整合到一个涵盖消费者和商业体验的‘超级应用程序’中。”

纳德拉表示，超级应用程序将于 2026 年夏末发布。

微软并没有在超级应用程序方面处于领先地位；而是在超级应用程序方面处于领先地位。他们只是最新一家赶上这一趋势的公司。 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 等人工智能公司也将重点放在超级应用上。

据路透社报道，OpenAI 已经向员工推出了其超级应用程序。 与此同时，竞争对手 Anthropic 最近宣布，也将其代理 Cowork 工具与其 Claude 聊天机器人结合起来。

超级应用程序还可以为人工智能公司完成其他事情。 由于用户可以直接在 ChatGPT 中访问 InstaCart、Uber、Zillow 和 OpenTable 等应用程序，因此这些代理超级应用程序可以将尽可能多的在线活动吸收到单个公司的应用程序中。

据报道，埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 也希望将 X 变成一款万能应用程序，而通过超级应用程序，他最大的人工智能竞争对手似乎正在朝着同一方向前进。

披露：Mashable 的母公司 Ziff Davis 于 2025 年 4 月对 OpenAI 提起诉讼，指控其在训练和运营其人工智能系统时侵犯了 Ziff Davis 的版​​权。
